sections.headline: A forest, not a classroom
sections.content:
> **Our Kids Temple is closed for Summer Holidays until mid September.**\
The covered space and outdoor playground remain available for families and children to use.

The Kids Temple embraces a Forest School ethos: nature as the classroom, and play as the way in. Every day is shaped around games and activities that awaken a child's social, physical, intellectual, emotional and spiritual sides — with plenty of room to simply follow their own curiosity. It exists for the children of residents, neighbors and guests alike, and for the parents who come with them.

columns.content:
#### Purpose

An inspiring space to awaken children to their full potential — and a way for more guests and lightworkers to come, knowing their kids are cared for.

#### Vision

Children welcomed into nature for a holistic, playful education — blossoming freely, while parents relax and share some time and skills in return.

#### Mission

An accessible, safe, inspiring space for children's and parents' growth in nature — building self-awareness, self-regulation, social skills and empathy.

sections.headline: Six ways children grow here
sections.content: _Beyond safety rules, children are never obliged to follow an activity at a given time — they're free to follow their bliss and curiosity until they're ready to join in._

cards.content:
#### Nature

Seeding, planting, growing, animal observation, eco constructions, land art.

#### Play

Games, ropes, swings, balls, circus.

#### Communicate

Social skills, compassion, empathy, sharing, expressing needs and boundaries, storytelling.

#### Blossom

Meditation, confidence, concentration, senses, belonging, arts and crafts.

#### Moving

Dancing, singing, kids & acro yoga, qigong, nature hikes, beach play & swimming.

#### Be Alive

Freedom, exploration, celebration, wonder, presence, gratitude.

columns.content:
### What's already there

Even over the summer break, families are welcome to enjoy:

- 1 dome (indoor space)
- 1 temple tent (shaded, outdoor)
- 1 natural pond
- 1 juice bar & 1 kitchen
- 1 playground with trampoline and swings
- Shower and toilets on site
- A forest tea room chill space for parents

### The previous rhythm

- Monday – Friday, 10:30am – 3pm
- Ages 2 – 10
- Music & movement, nature exploration & building, crafting & drawing
- Thursday gardening & Portuguese class woven in
- Organic snack & vegan lunch included; parents welcome to join Community Lunch for €8
- Thursdays close with the Forest SPA — €20/person, free for kids in the program
- English, German & Dutch spoken
- One day a month set aside for parents to connect on holistic education and their child's individual growth

### Parents are welcome to join

Parents are encouraged to spend a day a month — or more — in service of the temple and the children: assisting the facilitator, observing, sharing knowledge, offering a workshop, or helping build something for the space.

_These contributions help keep the program affordable, and make it richer for everyone._

### What to bring

Outdoor shoes & clothes, a hat, organic sun screen, swimming costume & gear, a rain coat, a warm jacket, a water bottle, and fruits or snacks.
